title: Slim Gaillard and Slam Stewart
summary: They talk about Slim Gaillard as dependable but unpredictable, and Slam Stewart's teaching and reunion with Benny Goodman.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Slim was sort of a fixture there wasn't he?
Yes he was. I don't ever know what happened to him. He'd show up for awhile and then disappear.
Right, right. He was very unpredictable.
Yeah, but he's dependable, but unpredictable.
Well he's such a great all around entertainer and everything.
Yeah, he done a lot of things didn't he? Him and Slam Stewart.
Oh, Slam was established I guess.

Yeah he's teaching and he works with -- at the __________ with Benny quite a bit -- over the past year and a half or so. Big Benny didn't -- guess didn't speak to him for about 15 years or something and then suddenly they got together again.
Slim had a lot of things that reminded me of Leo Watson a bit --
